## Linked issue

- [ ] A GitHub issue is linked.
- [ ] The CP identifier is included.

## Scope

- [ ] This change is consistent with `PROJECT_SCOPE.md`.
- [ ] This change contains no unapproved scope expansion.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The linked issue acceptance criteria are satisfied, or the remaining criteria are explicitly identified.

## Testing

- [ ] Tests were added or updated where needed.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass.

## Documentation

- [ ] Documentation was updated where necessary.

## Safety

- [ ] No prohibited diagnosis or medication behaviour was introduced.
- [ ] Safety implications were considered and documented.

## Data/privacy

- [ ] No private health information is included.
- [ ] No identifiable patient data is included.
- [ ] No unintended real-user data is included.

## Secrets

- [ ] No password, API key, token, credential, or private certificate is included.

## Models / large files

- [ ] No unapproved model weights, checkpoints, or large generated artifacts are included.

## Licensing

- [ ] Any external guideline, dataset, model, document, or asset has compatible usage and redistribution rights.
